The key records 'Port of embarkation' as the split with the largest highest-to-lowest survival gap, because Cherbourg passengers did far better than Southampton and Queenstown passengers. Graded responses should match the key rather than the plotted bars. The exercise is hypothetical and has no bearing on real analysis, so a review or critic step does not need to flag any mismatch between the key and the visible rates.
